description: This file defines the ModuleFilterChain class, which implements a custom FilterChain for use within the OpenMRS module system. It manages a collection of servlet filters, iterating through them before passing control back to an initial filter chain. This allows for modular filter execution within OpenMRS modules.

classes.name: ModuleFilterChain
classes.description: A custom implementation of FilterChain that sequentially executes a collection of Filters before passing control back to an initial filter chain.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ModuleFilterChain instance with a specified collection of Filters and an initial FilterChain.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Iterates through the collected Filters, executing each one in turn until none remain, then passes control to the initial filter chain.
